answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 43945 Country: United States of America Title: Interest Amount for Gift to cousin sister Question: Can we give gold items as gifts to Uncle's daughter for her marriage from interest money that earned from savings account (SBI)? Please note that my uncle is not a miskin or poor. But my uncle's daughter may be. Answer ID: 43945 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 350/350/M=1434) If the daughter of your uncle is poor and needy then you may give her the interest money from bank without the intention of reward and she can use that money where she wishes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
